title: App Composer nanochat challenge: baseline first, then under 90 minutes

execution.note: This file describes a proposed experiment. It does not provision compute or authorise spending.

baseline.hardware: One node with 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs
baseline.timing: Upstream total_training_time: training iterations, with upstream warm-up exclusions; evaluation and logging excluded

proposed_target.note: A target, not a result or a guarantee of upstream leaderboard acceptance.

phases: Freeze source, dependency lock, hardware, dataset/tokenizer hashes, evaluator bundle hashes and timing semantics.
Reproduce the pinned baseline, capturing full per-task evaluation and complete cost receipts.
Screen one hypothesis at a time using smaller models and a fixed development protocol.
For any Pufferfish-inspired candidate, validate dense warm-up, SVD transfer, chosen layers/ranks, and optimiser-state policy.
Run independent full-size baseline and candidate replications on equivalent hardware.
Publish every run, failed attempts, aggregates, complete commands and evidence before claiming an improvement.

candidate.description: Hypothesis to be selected after baseline reproduction; low-rank training is one candidate.
